title: Slowing as part of collision avoidance
summary: Reducing speed, stopping or reversing propulsion may be appropriate when the circumstances require it.
conditions: The depicted speed change is illustrative.
Rule 8 does not prescribe one stopping distance or timeline.

events.text: The depicted speed change is illustrative.

assumptions: Positions, timings, angles and separation are illustrative teaching choices, not rule-defined thresholds.
Motion is simplified and does not model hydrodynamics, stopping distance, current or sea state.
Vessel models and displayed lengths are scaled for legibility while preserving clearance between hulls.
Apply the COLREGs to the full circumstances; this scene is not an unconditional manoeuvring prescription.

sources.title: Convention on the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972 — Consolidated edition, 2018

steps.title: Identify the conditions
steps.body: The depicted speed change is illustrative. Rule 8 does not prescribe one stopping distance or timeline.

steps.title: Apply the rule
steps.body: Reducing speed, stopping or reversing propulsion may be appropriate when the circumstances require it.

steps.title: Check the outcome
steps.body: Continue to assess the other vessel and the effect of any action until the vessels are finally past and clear.
